 Ohio secretary of state-elect voices concerns after voter ID measure passes

 Brad Girod holds his 14-month-old daughter, Genevieve, as he votes at the National Veterans Memorial and Museum in Columbus, Ohio, on Tuesday. A measure requiring specific voter ID was passed in Ohio. (CAROLYN KASTER/AP) 
 By WSYX Staff | Sinclair National Desk PUBLISHED: November 5, 2026 at 10:56 AM EST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... With the passage of State Issue 3 by 65% to 35%, Ohio will now require certain forms of voter ID as part of its Constitution. New Secretary of State Allison Russo shared that she voted against Issue 3 and explained her reasoning. The new secretary of state-elect voted against the measure and says there could be legal issues with it.
